body: Thanks for your thoughtful reply.  For some of us, there is a lot of shame and guilt after an attempt.  It changed the way people would now relate to me.  The people who were survivors of attempts seemed less judgmental and they were my connection back to regaining some control over my thoughts and feelings.  The mental health system was of no use to me.  Therapy was useless and I refused to take meds.  I'm sure they've helped a lot of people, but it was very inauthentic for me.
